definitions.explanation: A store or business that sells goods in bulk or at wholesale prices, typically to retailers or businesses rather than individual consumers. Some wholesale shops also sell directly to the public.

examples.japanese: {卸売店|おろしうりてん}で{食材|しょくざい}を{仕入|しい}れる。
examples.english: To stock up on ingredients at a wholesale shop.

examples.japanese: {卸売店|おろしうりてん}のほうが{小売店|こうりてん}より{安|やす}い。
examples.english: Wholesale shops are cheaper than retail stores.

examples.japanese: {業務用|ぎょうむよう}の{卸売店|おろしうりてん}は{一般|いっぱん}{客|きゃく}も{利用|りよう}できることがある。
examples.english: Some commercial wholesale shops are also open to the general public.

examples.japanese: {築地|つきじ}{市場|しじょう}の{近|ちか}くには{海産物|かいさんぶつ}の{卸売店|おろしうりてん}がたくさんある。
examples.english: There are many seafood wholesale shops near Tsukiji Market.

notes:
Composed of {卸売|おろしうり} (wholesale) and {店|てん} (shop, store). Wholesale markets and shops are a significant part of Japan's distribution system. Famous wholesale districts include {築地|つきじ} (seafood), {太田|おおた}{市場|しじょう} (produce), and various {問屋街|とんやがい} (wholesale districts) in major cities.

The word {卸|おろし} originally referred to lowering goods from a storehouse, which came to mean selling goods in bulk to middlemen.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食品|しょくひん}{卸売店|おろしうりてん}: food wholesale shop
- {卸売店|おろしうりてん}で{仕入|しい}れる: to purchase stock from a wholesaler
- {卸売店|おろしうりてん}{価格|かかく}: wholesale shop price
- {卸売|おろしうり}{市場|しじょう}: wholesale market

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {問屋|とんや}: wholesaler — the traditional term, often used for long-established wholesale businesses
- {小売店|こうりてん}: retail shop — the counterpart that sells directly to consumers
- {卸売業者|おろしうりぎょうしゃ}: wholesale dealer — refers to the business entity rather than the physical shop
